description:
We are ORBITRAID, a team of Computer Science enthusiasts passionate about AI, software, and space technology.

For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are developing Field Shift, a smart farming web application using NASA POWER climate data, crop information, and farmer priorities to explore better crop rotation strategies.

Our skills include Python, React, FastAPI, databases, and AI-assisted development. Our goal is to make scientific data simple and useful for farmers.
